translations.web: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, that it’s good for a man to remain as he is.
translations.bsb: Because of the present crisis, I think it is good for a man to remain as he is.
translations.kjv: I suppose therefore that this is good for the present distress, I say, that it is good for a man so to be.
translations.asv: I think therefore that this is good by reason of the distress that is upon us, namely, that it is good for a man to be as he is.
